capabilities: browse date-stamped heading entries by day, week, or month
collect headings containing user-defined keyword terms into a Pinned tab
jump from an entry card to the source file at the exact heading
toggle and configure built-in date formats and keyword terms in settings
extras: The README devotes most of its length to a primer on how Obsidian plugins work, presenting the plugin as a reference implementation for plugin development rather than documenting more user features. Installation is by manually copying files rather than through the community plugin store.
problem: Notes written under date headings or keyword headings like TODO are scattered across files and hard to revisit without manually searching.
summary: Sidebar panel that scans the vault for date-format headings and keyword-marked headings, gathering entries into browsable day/week/month views and a pinned list.
